_comment: 017-edge-protection — the Free plan's single rate-limiting rule (research R7, FR-005): a human submits the lead form once; 5 POSTs in 10 s from one address is abuse, blocked at the edge for 10 s. The app's own limits (10/min, 100/day per address) stay.

rules.description: Lead form: 5 POST per 10 s per address
